title: Instructor Qualification Record
description: Safety training instructor qualification record per OSHA-KR Articles 29, 31, 32, 114 (안전보건교육 강사 자격).

qualification_type.description: KOSHA 인증 / 내부 자격 / 외부 전문가 / 안전관리자

qualification_number.description: Certificate number issued by the issuing authority

issuing_authority.description: Qualification issuing authority (발급기관, e.g., KOSHA, MOEL, internal safety department)

qualified_training_types.description: Training types this instructor may teach (정기/특별/관리감독자/신규채용/직무전환/응급조치/MSDS)

renewal_required.description: True if periodic renewal education is required before expiry

renewal_due_date.description: Deadline for renewal filing when renewal_required=true

courses_taught.description: Linked course references taught by this instructor (training-curriculum-record.json IDs)

verification_status.description: Qualification verification status against issuing authority records

legal_basis.description: Multi-source legal basis. Primary: OSHA-KR Article 29 §1 (worker safety education including instructor requirements) or Article 29 §3 + 시행규칙 §26 (special safety education for hazardous work) or Article 32 §1 (job education for 안전보건관리책임자 등 — 관리감독자 excluded) or Article 114 §1 (MSDS education). Adjacent laws may include: SAPA Article 4 (employer must ensure qualified instructors — safety and health assurance obligation), SAPA Article 5 (contract/subcontractor safety obligations). Records carry instructor PII (instructor_id, name, qualification_number) and MUST additionally cite PIPA (개인정보보호법): collection/use grounds (Art 15), destruction after retention period lapses (Art 21) — see regulations/KR/PIPA.yaml.
